name: ECOSHOP
recent: Eco-Shop 在 2026 年 11 月 4 日举行第 12 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有议案均获通过，包括设立新的雇员认股计划（ESOS）及委任 Deloitte 为新核数师。公司于 11 月期间多次因 ESOS 行使而发行新股，同时 EPF 持续买卖公司股份。第一季业绩显示营收同比增长 15.2%，但净利环比下降 13.0%。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上通过设立新的雇员认股计划（ESOS），规模最多为已发行股本的 5.0%。
第 12 届常年股东大会通过委任 Deloitte 为新核数师，取代退任的 PricewaterhouseCoopers。
公司因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，最新已发行股本增至约 57.6 亿股。
risks: ESOS 行使导致新股持续发行，可能对每股盈利造成摊薄。
第一季净利环比下降 13.0%，净利率从 9.4% 降至 8.0%。
董事及主要股东在 11 月期间有多笔股份交易，包括 ESOS 行使及 EPF 的买卖。
earnings: 第一季（截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日）营收为 RM793.68mil，同比增长 15.2%，环比增长 2.7%；净利为 RM63.19mil，同比增长 26.1%，但环比下降 13.0%。净利率为 8.0%，低于上一季度的 9.4%。

recent_en: Eco-Shop held its 12th AGM and an EGM on 4 November 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including the establishment of a new ESOS and the appointment of Deloitte as the new auditor. The company issued new shares multiple times during November due to ESOS exercises, while EPF continued to trade the shares. 1Q results showed revenue up 15.2% year-on-year, but net profit fell 13.0% quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the establishment of a new ESOS of up to 5.0% of issued shares at the EGM.
The 12th AGM approved the appointment of Deloitte as the new auditor, replacing the retiring PricewaterhouseCoopers.
The company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises, with latest issued share capital rising to about 5.76 billion shares.
risks_en: Continued issuance of new shares from ESOS exercises may dilute earnings per share.
1Q net profit fell 13.0% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin dropping from 9.4% to 8.0%.
Directors and major shareholders had multiple share transactions in November, including ESOS exercises and EPF trades.
earnings_en: 1Q (ended 31 August 2026) revenue was RM793.68 million, up 15.2% year-on-year and 2.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM63.19 million, up 26.1% year-on-year but down 13.0% quarter-on-quarter. Net margin was 8.0%, lower than 9.4% in the previous quarter.
